Understanding Local AI Assistants

Local AI assistants keep page content on the device. This reduces the risk of leaking confidential documents to third-party cloud inference APIs.

Key benefits

  • User-triggered page access only
  • Visible provider and data routing
  • Citations that jump back to the source

Limitations

On-device models may be slower or less capable than large cloud models. Hardware limits and first-time downloads should be communicated clearly.
